vsm2.16:49.5:
‘‘Yaṃ sokasallavihato paridevamāno,
Kaṇṭhoṭṭhatālutalasosajamappasayhaṃ;
Bhiyyodhimattamadhigacchatiyeva dukkhaṃ,
Dukkhoti tena bhagavā paridevamāhā’’ti.
vsm2.16:50.1: Dukkhaṃ nāma kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, taṃ kāyapīḷanalakkhaṇaṃ, duppaññānaṃ domanassakaraṇarasaṃ, kāyikābādhapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ.
vsm2.16:50.4:
‘‘Pīḷeti kāyikamidaṃ, dukkhañca mānasaṃ bhiyyo;
Janayati yasmā tasmā, dukkhanti visesato vutta’’nti.
vsm2.16:51.4: Cetodukkhasamappitā hi kese pakiriya kandanti, urāni paṭipisanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti, uddhaṃpādaṃ papatanti, satthaṃ āharanti, visaṃ khādanti, rajjuyā ubbandhanti, aggiṃ pavisantīti taṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhamanubhavanti.
vsm2.16:51.6:
‘‘Pīḷeti yato cittaṃ, kāyassa ca pīḷanaṃ samāvahati;
Dukkhanti domanassaṃ, vidomanassā tato āhū’’ti.
vsm2.16:52.1: Upāyāso nāma ñātibyasanādīhi phuṭṭhassa adhimattacetodukkhappabhāvito dosoyeva.
vsm2.16:52.4: Dukkho pana saṅkhāradukkhabhāvato cittaparidahanato kāyavisādanato ca.
vsm2.16:52.6:
‘‘Cittassa ca paridahanā, kāyassa visādanā ca adhimattaṃ;
Yaṃ dukkhamupāyāso, janeti dukkho tato vutto’’ti.
vsm2.16:53.1: Ettha ca mandagginā antobhājane pāko viya soko.
vsm2.16:53.2: Tikkhagginā paccamānassa bhājanato bahinikkhamanaṃ viya paridevo.
vsm2.16:53.3: Bahinikkhantāvasesassa nikkhamituṃ appahontassa antobhājaneyeva yāva parikkhayā pāko viya upāyāso daṭṭhabbo.
vsm2.16:55.5:
‘‘Ñātidhanādiviyogā,
Sokasarasamappitā vitujjanti;
Bālā yato tato yaṃ,
Dukkhoti mato piyavippayogo’’ti.
vsm2.16:56.1: Yampicchaṃ na labhatīti ettha ‘‘aho vata mayaṃ na jātidhammā assāmā’’tiādīsu (dī. ni. 2.398; vibha. 201) alabbhaneyyavatthūsu icchāva yampicchaṃ na labhati, tampi dukkhanti vuttā.
vsm2.16:58.1: Tathā hi indhanamiva pāvako, lakkhamiva paharaṇāni, gorūpaṃ viya ḍaṃsamakasādayo, khettamiva lāyakā, gāmaṃ viya gāmaghātakā upādānakkhandhapañcakameva jātiādayo nānappakārehi vibādhentā tiṇalatādīni viya bhūmiyaṃ, pupphaphalapallavāni viya rukkhesu upādānakkhandhesuyeva nibbattanti.
vsm2.16:59.1: Upādānakkhandhānañca ādidukkhaṃ jāti, majjhedukkhaṃ jarā, pariyosānadukkhaṃ maraṇaṃ, māraṇantikadukkhābhighātena pariḍayhanadukkhaṃ soko, tadasahanato lālappanadukkhaṃ paridevo, tato dhātukkhobhasaṅkhātaaniṭṭhaphoṭṭhabbasamāyogato kāyassa ābādhanadukkhaṃ dukkhaṃ, tena bādhiyamānānaṃ puthujjanānaṃ tattha paṭighuppattito cetobādhanadukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, sokādivuddhiyā janitavisādānaṃ anutthunanadukkhaṃ upāyāso, manorathavighātappattānaṃ icchāvighātadukkhaṃ icchitālābhoti evaṃ nānappakārato upaparikkhiyamānā upādānakkhandhāva dukkhāti.
vsm2.16:60.1: Yadetaṃ ekamekaṃ dassetvā vuccamānaṃ anekehipi kappehi na sakkā asesato vattuṃ, tasmā taṃ sabbampi dukkhaṃ ekajalabindumhi sakalasamuddajalarasaṃ viya yesu kesuci pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu saṃkhipitvā dassetuṃ ‘‘saṃkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā’’ti bhagavā avocāti.
vsm2.16:61.1: Samudayaniddese pana yāyaṃ taṇhāti yā ayaṃ taṇhā.
vsm2.16:61.2: Ponobbhavikāti punabbhavakaraṇaṃ punobbhavo, punobbhavo sīlametissāti ponobbhavikā.
vsm2.16:61.3: Nandīrāgena sahagatāti nandīrāgasahagatā, nandīrāgena saddhiṃ atthato ekattameva gatāti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm2.16:61.4: Tatra tatrābhinandinīti yatra yatra attabhāvo nibbattati, tatra tatrābhinandinī.
vsm2.16:61.5: Seyyathidanti nipāto, tassa sā katamāti ceti attho.
vsm2.16:61.6: Kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhāti imā paṭiccasamuppādaniddese āvibhavissanti.
vsm2.16:61.7: Idha panāyaṃ tividhāpi dukkhasaccassa nibbattakaṭṭhena ekattaṃ upanetvā dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccanti vuttāti veditabbā. Ayaṃ samudayaniddese nayo.
vsm2.16:62.1: Dukkhanirodhaniddese yo tassāyeva taṇhāyātiādinā nayena samudayanirodho vutto, so kasmāti ce?
vsm2.16:62.3: Samudayanirodhena hi dukkhaṃ nirujjhati, na aññathā.
vsm2.16:63.1: Iti yasmā samudayanirodheneva dukkhaṃ nirujjhati, tasmā bhagavā dukkhanirodhaṃ desento samudayanirodheneva desesi.
vsm2.16:63.3: Te dukkhaṃ nirodhentā dukkhanirodhañca desentā hetumhi paṭipajjanti, na phale.
vsm2.16:63.5: Te dukkhaṃ nirodhentā dukkhanirodhañca desentā attakilamathānuyogadesanādīhi phale paṭipajjanti, na hetumhīti.
vsm2.16:63.6: Evaṃ tāva dukkhanirodhassa samudayanirodhavasena desanāya payojanaṃ veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.16:64.1: Ayaṃ panattho – tassāyeva taṇhāyāti tassā ‘‘ponobbhavikā’’ti vatvā kāmataṇhādivasena vibhattataṇhāya.
vsm2.16:64.2: Virāgo vuccati maggo. ‘‘Virāgā vimuccatī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.245; saṃ. ni. 3.14) hi vuttaṃ.
vsm2.16:64.5: Atha vā virāgoti pahānaṃ vuccati, tasmā aseso virāgo aseso nirodhoti evampettha yojanā daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.16:65.1: Atthato pana sabbāneva etāni nibbānassa vevacanāni.
vsm2.16:65.2: Paramatthato hi dukkhanirodho ariyasaccanti nibbānaṃ vuccati.
vsm2.16:65.3: Yasmā pana taṃ āgamma taṇhā virajjati ceva nirujjhati ca, tasmā virāgoti ca nirodhoti ca vuccati.
vsm2.16:65.4: Yasmā ca tadeva āgamma tassā cāgādayo honti, kāmaguṇālayesu cettha ekopi ālayo natthi, tasmā ‘‘cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo’’ti vuccati.
vsm2.16:66.1: Tayidaṃ santilakkhaṇaṃ, accutirasaṃ, assāsakaraṇarasaṃ vā, animittapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ, nippapañcapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ vā.
